{{Quote|This hideout demonstrates one of the great dangers of being a Meatlump. Not to life and limb...what could possibly harm a Meatlump? I'm talking about excess anger.|The [[Meatlump King]]|<ref name="SWG:TMK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|The Meatlump King|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Meatlump Hideout''' was the headquarters of the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located within abandoned maintenance tunnels beneath [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].

==Description==
{{Quote|These rugs really tie the room together.|Meatlump King|<ref name="SWG:TMK" />}}
[[File:Meatlumps_Hideout_entrance.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The entrance of the hideout.]]
The Meatlump Hideout was used by the gang of technology-hating [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] known as the [[Meatlumps]]. They had managed to keep the existence and the location of their hideout totally secret.<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" />

The hideout was located beneath the streets of Corellia's [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], within some abandoned [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels|maintenance tunnels]]. The hideout was made of multiple rooms and tunnels over several floors. The main entrance was located at the lowest flour of some kind of abandoned warehouse in Coronet.<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" />

The largest room of the hideout served as a "throne room" for the [[Meatlump King]], the fabled leader of the Meatlumps whose existence was as mysterious as the Meatlump Hideout itself. The king held court here for his followers.<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref>

The Meatlump Hideout was infested by with rodents, including [[meetle]]s and [[worrmp]]s.<ref name="SWG:WO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Wine-O}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Meatlumps_Hideout_throne_room.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The "throne room".]]
{{Quote|These chambers and tunnels are my Empire, though it is most definitely not divided. All Meatlumps are welcome here.|Meatlump King|<ref name="SWG:TMK" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the activities of the Meatlumps were investigated by the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Vani Korr]].<ref name="SWG:HVKItM">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Help Vani Korr Investigate the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she recruited an adventurer to help her in her investigation. The spacer encountered the Meatlump [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kaiya Merel]] and pretended to want to join the gang. The traveler lured the Meatlump lieutenant and, after some successful missions, was eventually accepted among the Meatlumps.<ref name="SWG:TMHP7">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 7|Corellia}}</ref> Kaiya Merel gave to her new recruit full access to the secret Meatlump Hideout.<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" /> The spacer was one of the few non-Meatlumps who entered the Meatlump Hideout and finally encountered the Meatlump King. The information gathered in the hideout allowed Vani Korr to finalize her article ''[[Who are the Meatlumps?]]''. She revealed the presence of the Meatlump Hideout below the streets of Coronet and the existence of the Meatlump King.<ref name="SWG:MtM" />

Beyond the Meatlump King, other Meatlumps operating in the hideout following the Battle of Yavin included [[Hraykken Bender]], [[Snugli Explevey]], Recruiter [[Joe]], [[Balia Alloo]], [[Chef/Legends|Chef]] [[Schlump]], Assistant Chef [[Schlap]], Lieutenant [[Dorvin Kanu]], Lieutenant [[Cyru Sarkee]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Loman Vosso]], [[Decider]] [[Ximo Tacx]], [[Newin Seedel]], Captain [[Coptszt]], [[Gitchur Lumpback]], and two Meatlump [[drooler]]s.<ref name="SWG:MTP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}"Meatlumps Theme Park" on Corellia</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Meatlump Hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Meatlump Hideout was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
